hook: Your five-year career plan is dead, and the 30-year ladder failed.

sections.voiceover: Your five-year career plan is dead, and the 30-year ladder failed.
Dr. Diane Hamilton reports that AI makes traditional five-year plans obsolete today. Why do these 5-year and 30-year career models crumble in today's disruptive job market?
Journalist Farai Chideya’s book, The Episodic Career, explains how we navigate this increasingly disruptive landscape.

This book documents how professionals navigate an episodic approach instead of a traditional linear path. Sanjay Menon of Publicis Sapient India says episodic work replaces the 30-year hierarchy for relevance.
Ditch the 30-year climb and embrace 5-year episodic cycles to secure your future.
